name: Sparse-Cube + Strong WD + Up-scaled Init
tagline: Train on the 2^K cube of secret bits with all non-secret features zeroed; Kaiming first-layer init scaled by sqrt(N/K); AdamW lr=0.01, wd=0.3.

key_hyperparams.name: wd
key_hyperparams.role: AdamW weight decay (30x default) → drives non-secret W to 0

key_hyperparams.name: first_layer_scale
key_hyperparams.role: compensates Kaiming for K active inputs

key_hyperparams.name: non_secret_features
key_hyperparams.role: uses secret to mask out distractor bits

init_recovers: default xavier+xavier init under uniform random data when scale=1 and wd=1e-2
diff_from_baseline: Uses the secret to construct a 'feature isolation' dataset that zeros all non-secret features and enumerates the 2^K secret cube; couples this with Kaiming first-layer init scaled by sqrt(N/K) and AdamW lr/wd raised to 0.01/0.3 so non-secret weights decay to zero.

name: Cube + 80% Zero Background + Mild WD
tagline: Enumerate secret cube on a 20k-example dataset with 80% zero-background / 20% random non-secret bits and 10% fully random; Kaiming init.

key_hyperparams.name: p_zero_bg
key_hyperparams.role: fraction of cube examples with non-secret bits zeroed

key_hyperparams.name: first_layer_bias_init
key_hyperparams.role: small positive bias to keep ReLU alive

diff_from_baseline: Combines the multi_epoch baseline's smaller dataset (here 20k) with a structured generator that enumerates the 2^K secret cube under an 80/20 zero-vs-random non-secret background and a 10% fully-random tail; tunes Kaiming first layer + small Xavier second layer and slightly lowers lr to 5e-4 with wd 1e-3.

name: Balanced Cube + Skewed (p=0.1) Mixture
tagline: 1M balanced cube samples + 2M heavily-skewed (p=0.1 on secret bits, 0 on non-secret) samples; Xavier with sqrt(N/32) gain.

key_hyperparams.name: skewed_size
key_hyperparams.role: heavily skewed examples to give gradient signal

key_hyperparams.name: skewed_p
key_hyperparams.role: Bernoulli rate on secret bits in skewed set

key_hyperparams.name: first_layer_gain
key_hyperparams.role: Xavier gain scaled to N=32 reference

key_hyperparams.name: first_layer_bias_init
key_hyperparams.role: non-zero bias to break ReLU symmetry

diff_from_baseline: Uses the secret only inside make_dataset to build a balanced 2^K-cube subset (1M) plus a skewed 2M subset where secret bits are Bernoulli(0.1) and non-secret bits zero; init scales first layer by sqrt(N/32)*sqrt(2) and uses N(0,1) bias; AdamW lr/wd bumped to 5e-3 / 2e-2.

name: Antithetic Init + Cube + Anchored Nuisances
tagline: Antithetic ±W initialization with biases set so all ReLUs are open at zero, dataset = secret cube × small set of (zero, all-ones, e_i) non-secret anchors.

key_hyperparams.name: antithetic_pairs
key_hyperparams.role: stack base and -base for variance balance

diff_from_baseline: Replaces Xavier with antithetic ±W_1 pairs of std 0.25/sqrt(N) and a bias rule that pre-activates every ReLU at zero; replaces random data with the cross product of the 2^K secret cube and a (d+2)-row anchor set on non-secret bits (zero, all-ones, single-bit e_i); AdamW lr=2e-3, β₂=0.99.
